shortcuts.choice3: Sign in the third way listed

signIn.title: Sign in to Campbooks
signIn.lead: What needs you, in one calm place. Campbooks reads your mail and brings you only what needs you.
signIn.invitedTitle: Sign in to join the workspace
signIn.invitedLead: Use the email address the invitation was sent to, and you’ll join straight away.

gmail.summary: Google will also ask to let Campbooks use your Gmail, so your first mailbox is ready when you are.
gmail.keeps: Campbooks keeps your name, your address and the permission Google gives it. It never sees your Google password.
gmail.reads: That permission lets Campbooks read and organise the mail in this Gmail account. Nothing is connected to a workspace until you say so, and a permission you don’t use is deleted after 7 days.
gmail.optional: You can untick mail access on Google’s screen. You’ll still be signed in, and your mail simply won’t be connected.
gmail.existing: If you already have an account, signing in doesn’t change any mailbox you’ve connected.

signIn.unverified: Google may warn that it hasn’t verified this app. Google checks every app that can read Gmail, and that check isn’t finished yet. To carry on, choose “Advanced”, then continue to the app.
signIn.footer: Source available. Your mail stays in your workspace.
signIn.loading: Loading the ways to sign in…

noWayIn.title: Signing in isn’t set up yet
noWayIn.lead: This Campbooks has no way to sign in turned on. Ask whoever runs it to set up Google sign-in.

expired.title: This sign-in page has expired
expired.lead: It waited too long. Start again; nothing was lost.

failed.title: Couldn’t load the ways to sign in
failed.lead: Campbooks didn’t answer. Check your connection, then try again.

signIn.passkeySignUp: New here? Create an account with a passkey

passkeyField.label: Saved passkeys
passkeyField.hint: Your browser offers the passkeys you saved for Campbooks here.

cancelled.title: No passkey was used.
cancelled.lead: Try again when you’re ready, or sign in another way.

not_accepted.title: That passkey wasn’t accepted.
not_accepted.lead: It may have been removed from your account. Try another passkey, or sign in another way.

rate_limited.title: Too many tries.
rate_limited.lead: Wait a minute, then try again.

failed.title: Couldn’t sign in with a passkey.
failed.lead: Something went wrong. Try again, or sign in another way.

suspended.title: This account is suspended.
suspended.lead: Whoever runs this Campbooks suspended it. Ask them to restore it.

cancelled_at_provider.title: You cancelled on the sign-in screen.
cancelled_at_provider.lead: Nothing was created. Choose a way to sign in when you’re ready.

invalid_state.title: That sign-in can’t be finished.
invalid_state.lead: It took too long, or it was opened in another browser. Start again in this one.

provider_unavailable.title: The sign-in provider didn’t answer.
provider_unavailable.lead: Nothing changed. Wait a moment, then try again.

login_failed.title: The sign-in provider couldn’t confirm who you are.
login_failed.lead: Try again, or sign in another way.

way_in_belongs_to_another_account.title: This account already signs in to another Campbooks account.
way_in_belongs_to_another_account.lead: Sign in with it to use that account.

signup_invite_only.title: This Campbooks is by invitation only.
signup_invite_only.lead: Nobody has invited this address yet, and nothing was kept. Ask someone who uses it to invite you, then sign in with the address they invite.

unknown.title: Something went wrong while signing in.

account_suspended.title: This account is suspended.
account_suspended.lead: Whoever runs this Campbooks suspended it. Ask them to restore it.

newAccount.title: Create your Campbooks account
newAccount.leadNoEmail: No Campbooks account uses this {{provider}} account yet.
newAccount.nameNote: This is the name {{provider}} gave us. People in your workspaces will see it.
newAccount.next1: Your account is created, and you sign in with this {{provider}} account.
newAccount.next3: If you let Campbooks use your mail, you choose whether to connect it to that workspace.
newAccount.footer: Already use Campbooks with another account? Sign in with that one instead.

gone.title: This sign-up isn’t waiting any more
gone.lead: It took too long, or it was started in another browser. Sign in again to start over.

loadFailed.title: Couldn’t load your new account
loadFailed.lead: Campbooks didn’t answer. Check your connection, then try again.

mailbox.title: Your Gmail {{address}} will be connected to this workspace
mailbox.titleOther: Your mailbox {{address}} will be connected to this workspace
mailbox.lead: Campbooks reads the mail in it, keeps a copy of what it reads so it can show it to you here, and keeps checking for new mail.
mailbox.later: Not now keeps it waiting on Home until {{date}}.
mailbox.signIn: Disconnecting it later doesn’t stop you signing in with this account.

gone.title: That mailbox isn’t waiting any more.
gone.lead: Its permission expired or was already used, so it can’t be connected from here.

taken.title: Someone else here already connected it.
taken.lead: Another member of this workspace connected {{address}}.

unsupported.title: Campbooks can’t read this mailbox yet.

offer.title: Connect {{address}}
offer.lead: This mailbox has been waiting since you signed up. Connect it to {{workspace}} and Campbooks will bring what needs you here.
offer.confirmForget: Forget {{address}}? Campbooks deletes the permission Google gave it. You can still sign in with this account.

waysIn.title: Ways to sign in
waysIn.lead: You can sign in to Campbooks with any of these accounts. Every mailbox you connect becomes one too.
waysIn.loading: Loading your ways to sign in…

loadError.title: Couldn’t load your ways to sign in
loadError.lead: Campbooks didn’t answer. Check your connection, then try again.

waysIn.confirmRemove: Stop signing in with {{provider}} ({{address}})? Any mailbox you connected with it stays connected.
waysIn.confirmRemoveOnly: Stop signing in with {{provider}} ({{address}})? Any mailbox you connected with it stays connected. You need another way to sign in first.

lastWayIn.title: This is your only way to sign in.
lastWayIn.lead: Add another way first, then remove this one.

waysIn.needsReconnect: Its mailbox in this workspace stopped syncing. Reconnect it to carry on.
waysIn.addTitle: Add a way to sign in
waysIn.addLead: Sign in with another account you own. You confirm it at the provider, and it’s added here.
waysIn.addNone: This Campbooks offers no sign-in provider. Ask whoever runs it to set one up.

stepUp.title: Sign in again first
stepUp.lead: For your security, changing how you sign in needs a sign-in in the last 10 minutes.

waysIn.linked: You can now sign in with {{provider}}.

way_in_belongs_to_another_account.title: That account already signs in to another Campbooks account.
way_in_belongs_to_another_account.lead: Nothing was moved or merged. Sign in with it to use that account.

sign_in_again.title: Sign in again to do that.
sign_in_again.lead: This browser isn’t signed in as you any more. Sign in, then try again.

login_failed.title: The provider couldn’t confirm the account.

provider_unavailable.title: The provider didn’t answer.
provider_unavailable.lead: Nothing changed. Wait a moment, then try again.

consent_incomplete.title: Mail access wasn’t allowed.
consent_incomplete.lead: You can sign in with that account now, but its mailbox isn’t connected. Try again and allow mail access.

account_mismatch.title: That’s a different account.
account_mismatch.lead: Reconnect with the account this mailbox belongs to.

account_connected_by_another_member.title: Someone else here already connected it.
account_connected_by_another_member.lead: Another member of this workspace connected that mailbox.

recent.title: A way to sign in was added this week
recent.lead: It’s marked New below. If you didn’t add it, remove it, then sign out everywhere.

everywhere.title: Sign out everywhere
everywhere.lead: Ends every sign-in to your account: this browser, your other devices and every app you allowed. Do it if you lose a device or see a way to sign in you didn’t add.
everywhere.confirmLead: Sign out of Campbooks on every device and in every app, this browser included? You’ll sign in again here next.
everywhere.failed: Couldn’t sign out everywhere. Nothing changed; try again.

passkeySignUp.title: Create an account with a passkey
passkeySignUp.lead: Your device keeps the passkey and unlocks it with your face, fingerprint or screen lock. There’s no password.
passkeySignUp.footer: No email address is needed. You can add Google, Microsoft or Zoho later.

name.label: What should we call you?
name.hint: Shown in Campbooks and to the people you invite.
name.required: Tell us what to call you.

passkeySignUp.next1: Your device asks to save a passkey for Campbooks.
passkeySignUp.next3: You connect a mailbox whenever you’re ready.

cancelled.title: No passkey was made.
cancelled.lead: Nothing was created. Try again when you’re ready.

exists.title: This device already has a passkey for that.

not_accepted.title: That passkey wasn’t accepted.
not_accepted.lead: Nothing was created. Try again, or use another device.

inviteOnly.title: This Campbooks takes invited people only
inviteOnly.lead: Sign in with the account your invitation was sent to. You can add a passkey once you’re in.

unsupported.title: This browser can’t use passkeys
unsupported.lead: Use another browser or device, or sign in another way.

passkeys.title: Passkeys
passkeys.lead: Sign in with your face, fingerprint or screen lock instead of a provider. Passkeys can’t be phished.
passkeys.added: {{name}} is added. You can sign in with it now.
passkeys.confirmRemove: Stop signing in with {{name}}? It stays on your device until you delete it there, and anyone signed in with it is signed out.

renameFailed.title: Couldn’t rename it.
renameFailed.lead: Use 1 to 64 characters, then try again.

passkeys.unsupported: This browser can’t make passkeys. Use another browser or device to add one.

exists.title: This device already has a passkey for your account.

notAccepted.title: That passkey wasn’t accepted.
notAccepted.lead: Nothing was added. Try again, or use another device.

passkeys.freshSignIn: For your security, adding a passkey needs a sign-in from the last five minutes. Sign in again; it takes you straight back here.

admin.title: Account
admin.noAccount: No account details here: this Campbooks signs people in with another identity provider, or the account is gone.
admin.noWaysIn: No provider account. They sign in with a passkey only.
admin.suspendHint: Stops this person from signing in. Nothing is deleted.
admin.unsuspendHint: Lets this person sign in again. They start a new sign-in.
admin.confirmSuspend: Suspend {{name}}? They are signed out everywhere at once and can’t sign in again until you unsuspend them. Their workspaces, mail and documents stay as they are.

isAdmin.title: This person is an administrator.
isAdmin.lead: Revoke their admin profile on the server first (campbooks-server admin revoke), then suspend them.

done.suspended: {{name}} is suspended and signed out everywhere.

consent.loading: Loading what the app asks for…
consent.title: {{app}} wants to use your Campbooks account

kind.dynamic: Registered itself. Nobody has checked who made it.
kind.metadata_document: Described by {{host}}. Nobody has checked who made it.

consent.workspaceLead: It sees and changes only that workspace.
consent.allWorkspaces: It will work in all your workspaces, like Campbooks on the web.

noWorkspace.title: Join a workspace first
noWorkspace.lead: This app works inside a workspace, and you aren’t in one yet.

consent.goesToDevice: Next, you’ll go back to an app on this device.

device.title: Only if you just started this
device.lead: An app on this device asked for this. Allow it only if you started signing in from that app yourself, just now: any app on this device can ask, and it would act as you.

unverifiedNote.title: Anyone can register an app with any name
unverifiedNote.lead: Allow it only if you trust where you came from.

consent.remembered: You won’t be asked again for this app. Revoke it any time in Settings → Apps and integrations.
consent.everyTime: You’ll be asked each time this app signs in. Revoke it any time in Settings → Apps and integrations.

stepUp.title: Sign in again first
stepUp.lead: Letting an app in needs a sign-in from the last ten minutes.

gone.title: This request is no longer waiting
gone.lead: It expired, was already answered, or was meant for someone else. Start again from the app.

failed.title: Couldn’t load this request
failed.lead: Campbooks didn’t answer. Check your connection, then try again.

scopes.openid: Know who you are on Campbooks
scopes.offline_access: Stay connected when you’re away, until you revoke it
scopes.system_read: See whether this Campbooks is working
scopes.workspaces_read: See your workspaces and their members
scopes.workspaces_write: Create workspaces and change their settings
scopes.connectors_read: See the mailboxes connected to a workspace
scopes.conversations_write: Reply, send, archive and sort your conversations
scopes.identity_read: See your account and how you sign in

apps.title: Apps and integrations
apps.lead: Apps you let into your account, and this workspace’s own apps.

loadError.title: Couldn’t load your apps
loadError.lead: Campbooks didn’t answer. Try again in a moment.

connected.title: Connected apps
connected.lead: Apps that can act as you. Revoking one stops it at once.
connected.empty: No app can act as you.
connected.confirmRevoke: {{app}} stops working at once, until you allow it again.

workspace.title: This workspace’s apps
workspace.lead: Integrations of {{workspace}}: server-to-server apps with a secret, and sign-in apps that people allow.
workspace.notAdmin: Only owners and admins can manage this workspace’s apps.
workspace.name: Name

typeLeads.confidential: Runs on a server with a secret, acting for the workspace (client credentials).
typeLeads.public: People sign in through it and allow it, one by one.

accessLeads.read: See the workspace’s mail and settings.
accessLeads.write: Also reply, send, sort and connect mailboxes.

workspace.redirectHint: Where people come back after allowing it: https://… or http://127.0.0.1:port/…
workspace.secretLead: It’s shown only this once. Keep it somewhere safe; if it’s lost, rotate it.
workspace.confirmRotate: The current secret of {{app}} stops working at once.
workspace.confirmRemove: {{app}} and every token it holds stop working.

errors.name: Give it a name.
errors.redirect: Use an https address, or http://127.0.0.1 with a port.

stepUp.title: Sign in again first
stepUp.lead: Creating or rotating a secret needs a sign-in from the last ten minutes.
